name: Rennoshin
source:
"I'm not looking for love. 
I have devoted my life to medicine."

He has studied medicine under many teachers, and he has been offered positions as a doctor by many feudal lords, but he has chosen to keep following the path to improvement to deepen his knowledge. Ren even came to Iga to further his studies. Some people are deeply moved by his desire to save lives. His only flaw is that once he falls asleep, not even an earthquake can move him. He tends to sleep anywhere he wants, which has caused considerable trouble in the past.
